name: io.github.om-tajne/pkgdiet
description: Local npm dependency-policy checks for compatible MCP clients.

tools.name: check_dependency
tools.description: Evaluate one npm package against the active local dependency policy.

tools.name: check_dependencies
tools.description: Evaluate multiple npm packages with bounded concurrency.

tools.name: suggest_alternative
tools.description: Return curated replacement candidates for a package.

tools.name: get_policy
tools.description: Return the effective local policy and validation result.

limitations: MCP tools are advisory and do not force client compliance.
PkgDiet does not install packages or modify project files through MCP.
